# RenderPhoenix

> RenderPhoenix is an independent interactive creative studio from Bangladesh building standalone games, 3D environments, real-time game assets, and digital experiences.

## Studio Overview
- **Official Name**: RenderPhoenix
- **Founder**: Tasrif Ibn Mizan (2019)
- **Studio Revival**: Cristo Parker (22 August 2026)
- **Primary Website**: https://renderphoenix.com/
- **Verified MCPEDL Profile**: https://mcpedl.com/user/renderphoenix/
- **Key Capabilities**: Game Development (Unreal Engine, Unity), 3D World Design (Blender), Real-Time Asset Production, Technical Art, Interactive Experiences.

## Key Timeline & History
- **2019**: Established under the original name Minehutt by Tasrif Ibn Mizan. Focus on community maps and virtual city environments.
- **22 February 2021**: Renamed to RenderPhoenix to mark expansion into 3D art and asset pipelines.
- **1 August 2022**: Overcame a major security incident compromising primary digital accounts, continuing active releases through 2024.
- **2024**: Studio entered a period of inactivity as original team members pursued software engineering and higher education.
- **2025**: Awarded **Regional Runner-Up** in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025 for an interactive lunar habitat simulator.
- **22 August 2026**: Rebuilt and officially revived by Cristo Parker into a full-scale game and 3D creative studio.

## Selected Projects
- **Lunar Habitat Simulator (NASA Space Apps 2025)**: Regional Runner-Up project featuring 3D lunar city planning and environmental life support simulation.
- **Banglamine City**: Large-scale urban city map inspired by Bangladeshi architecture and metropolitan infrastructure.
- **Zombiepolis**: Post-apocalyptic urban survival map featuring environmental storytelling and overgrown skyscraper districts.
- **Frostcraft**: Sub-zero survival settlement map inspired by Frostpunk mechanics.
- **Add-ons & UI**: DHK Rickshaw Addon, Bangladeshi Vehicles Addon, Phoenix Bicycle, Discord Theme UI, Clash of Clans Theme UI.
